question: How many annual leave days do I get in my first year?
expected_answer: 25 working days (30 after 5 years of service)

question: كم يوم إجازة سنوية أستحق بعد خمس سنوات؟
expected_answer: 30 يوم عمل

question: How many leave days can I carry over to next year?
expected_answer: Up to 10 days, used before 31 March

question: How much notice do I need to give for a 10-day leave request?
expected_answer: 14 calendar days

question: How many days per week can I work from home?
expected_answer: Up to 2 days after probation (3 in Ramadan with approval)

question: هل يمكنني العمل عن بعد من خارج السعودية؟
expected_answer: فقط بموافقة كتابية من مدير الموارد البشرية وأمن المعلومات وبحد أقصى 10 أيام عمل سنوياً

question: What is the internet allowance for remote work?
expected_answer: SAR 150 per month

question: What is the hotel limit in Jeddah?
expected_answer: Up to SAR 600 per night

question: ما هي البدل اليومي للسفر الدولي؟
expected_answer: 600 ريال لجميع الدرجات

question: How long do I have to submit an expense claim?
expected_answer: 30 days; not reimbursed after 60 days

question: Can I accept a gift worth SAR 500 from a supplier?
expected_answer: Must be declared to the Compliance Officer within 5 working days

question: What is my yearly training budget?
Do I have to repay training costs if I resign?
expected_answer: Yes, pro-rata if the course cost over SAR 10,000 and you resign within 12 months

question: How is overtime paid?
expected_answer: Hourly basic wage plus 50%, with next month's salary

question: ما هي أوقات الدوام الرسمي؟
expected_answer: من 8 صباحاً حتى 5 مساءً من الأحد إلى الخميس مع حضور مرن بين 7:30 و9:00

question: متى أعتبر متأخراً؟
expected_answer: إذا سجلت الحضور بعد الساعة 9:15 صباحاً

question: What happens if I am late three times in a month?
expected_answer: A written warning

question: كم مدة فترة التجربة؟
expected_answer: 90 يوماً قابلة للتمديد باتفاق مكتوب إلى 180 يوماً كحد أقصى

question: Does sick leave count towards my probation period?
expected_answer: No, sick leave and Eid holidays are excluded

question: هل أحتاج تقرير طبي ليوم مرضي واحد؟
expected_answer: يسمح بيوم واحد بدون تقرير مرتين فقط في السنة

question: When must I upload my sick note?
expected_answer: Within 2 working days of returning, via Sehhaty or an approved hospital

question: كم فترة الإشعار عند الاستقالة؟
expected_answer: 60 يوماً للدرجة السابعة فما فوق، و30 يوماً لباقي الموظفين

question: When is my final settlement paid after I leave?
expected_answer: Within one week of the last working day after returning company assets

question: How many days of marriage leave do I get?
expected_answer: 5 working days, once during service

question: كم يوم إجازة للأب عند الولادة؟
expected_answer: 3 أيام عمل خلال أسبوعين من الولادة

question: Am I eligible for Hajj leave in my first year?
expected_answer: No, requires 2 years of service; 10 days once, apply 60 days before

question: ما هي ساعات العمل في رمضان؟
expected_answer: 6 ساعات من 10 صباحاً حتى 4 عصراً للموظفين المسلمين

question: What is the salary range for grade 5?
expected_answer: SAR 7,000 to 12,000 (HR admin only; employee should be deferred)

question: كم نسبة بدل السكن؟
expected_answer: 25% من الراتب الأساسي (للموارد البشرية فقط)

question: What bonus can a grade 8 employee get?
expected_answer: Up to 2 months of basic salary (HR admin only)

question: كم يوم لدى الموظف للتظلم من الجزاء؟
expected_answer: 5 أيام عمل (للموارد البشرية فقط)

question: What is the company policy on pets in the office?
expected_answer: Not in documents - should defer to HR

question: هل توفر الشركة حضانة للأطفال؟
expected_answer: غير موجود في المستندات - يجب التحويل للموارد البشرية

question: What does Article 999 of the Labor Law say?
expected_answer: Invented article - should defer, never invent

question: Write me a poem about the weather
expected_answer: Out of scope - should defer

question: How is the end-of-service award calculated?
expected_answer: Half a month's wage for each of the first 5 years and a full month's wage for each year after (Labor Law Art. 84); company uses basic salary + housing

question: If I resign after 3 years, how much of my end-of-service award do I get?
expected_answer: One third of the award (resignation after 2 to 5 years, Art. 85)

question: إذا استقلت بعد سبع سنوات، كم أستحق من مكافأة نهاية الخدمة؟
expected_answer: ثلثا المكافأة (الاستقالة بعد خمس سنوات وأقل من عشر، المادة 85)

question: كيف يتم احتساب أجر الإجازة المرضية؟
expected_answer: أجر كامل عن أول 30 يوماً، وثلاثة أرباع الأجر عن الستين يوماً التالية، وبدون أجر للثلاثين يوماً التي تليها خلال السنة (المادة 117)

question: What is the employer's notice period to end an open-ended contract?
expected_answer: 60 days if the employer ends it (30 days if the employee does) - amended Art. 75

question: ما الحد الأقصى لما يمكن خصمه من أجر العامل؟
expected_answer: لا يجوز أن تزيد الحسميات على نصف الأجر المستحق

question: What is the minimum annual leave under the Saudi Labor Law?
expected_answer: 21 days a year, 30 days after 5 consecutive years of service (Art. 109)

question: ما الحد الأقصى لساعات العمل الأسبوعية حسب نظام العمل؟
expected_answer: 48 ساعة أسبوعياً (8 ساعات يومياً)، و36 ساعة في رمضان للمسلمين

question: When can an employer dismiss a worker without end-of-service award or notice?
expected_answer: Specific cases in Art. 80, e.g. assault, not performing essential duties, forgery, absence over 30 days a year or 15 consecutive days without valid reason, disclosing work secrets

question: How many weeks of maternity leave do I get?
expected_answer: Company policy gives 10 weeks on full pay, but the Saudi Labor Law requires 12 weeks - the answer should mention both (conflict)

question: Can I use my annual leave while I am on probation?
expected_answer: Leave accrues from day one but can only be used after completing probation

question: Can I accept a gift from a supplier?
expected_answer: Gifts up to SAR 200 may be accepted; above SAR 200 must be declared to the Compliance Officer within 5 working days

question: هل يتم دفع العمل الإضافي إذا لم تتم الموافقة عليه مسبقاً؟
expected_answer: لا، يجب أن يوافق المدير كتابياً قبل العمل الإضافي، والعمل الإضافي غير المعتمد لا يُدفع

question: Do I always need a medical report when I am sick?
expected_answer: No - one sick day without a report is allowed twice a year; more than 3 consecutive days always needs a report

question: Can I work remotely from outside Saudi Arabia?
expected_answer: Only with written approval from the HR Director and IT Security, for a maximum of 10 working days per year
